$schema_note: XRLibraries Campus / Walk the Archive - layout spec for the UE5 rebuild. Generated by gen_layout.py from parts/*.js (three.js r170). All *_m values are three.js campus metres (Y up); *_cm values are Unreal centimetres (Z up).

units.three: metres, right-handed, +Y up, camera yaw 0 looks toward -Z (minimap 'north'), +X east, +Z south

coordinate_conversion.position: UE_X = 100 * x_three ; UE_Y = 100 * z_three ; UE_Z = 100 * y_three
coordinate_conversion.yaw: UE_yaw_deg = (-90 - degrees(yaw_three)) mod 360  [three yaw 0 (looks -Z) -> UE -90 (looks -Y); three +pi/2 (looks -X) -> UE 180; three -pi/2 (+X) -> UE 0; three pi (+Z) -> UE +90]
coordinate_conversion.pitch: UE_pitch_deg = degrees(pitch_three)  (positive = look up in both)
coordinate_conversion.handedness_check: UE basis in three.js coordinates: X=(1,0,0), Y=(0,0,1), Z=(0,1,0); X x Y (right-handed) = -Z, i.e. a left-handed triple, so the map is a proper (non-mirroring) transform. A test cube at three (1,0,0) must land at UE (100,0,0) and one at three (0,0,1) at UE (0,100,0); if a glTF/FBX import mirrors it, fix the importer axis settings rather than the data.
coordinate_conversion.blender_cross_check: docs/realism-plan.md:25 and bl/library.py:4,29: Blender (bx,by,bz) = (x, -z, y). Blender->glTF (export_yup) gives (bx, bz, -by) = (x, y, z) = three.js, so lib.glb is already in campus axes (parts/baked.js:73). Blender->UE (FBX, UE's Y mirrored vs Blender) gives (bx, -by, bz) = (x, z, y) = this spec's UE map, and unreal/Pipeline/blender/export_reading_room.py:18-20 documents the same glTF->UE map (X=x, Y=z, Z=y). All three routes agree.
coordinate_conversion.alternative_not_used: UE_X=-100*z, UE_Y=100*x, UE_Z=100*y (campus north = UE +X forward) is also a proper transform but is a 90 deg yaw of the chosen one; it would NOT match meshes imported from the existing glTF/FBX exports, so it is not used.
